# B03 — List by tag (local)

Add `list-tag --tag VALUE`. Return tasks whose `tags` contains exactly VALUE
(case-sensitive; query input is not trimmed), including completed tasks, in
normal order. Reject blank or whitespace-only query input with `invalid_tag`.
A tag not present returns `[]`; the query never changes storage. For example,
`work` does not select a task tagged `Work`.

context.scope: B03 local list-by-tag change to the existing task CLI under the frozen shared benchmark contract; requirements/README.md retains cumulative compatibility. No other-track implementation or hidden oracle is authority.

domains.query: CLI string VALUE; blank/whitespace-only rejected; other VALUE compared verbatim
domains.tasks: Valid task records with tags, pending or completed
domains.order: (created_at, id) ascending per frozen shared contract

parameters.result: Read/list task query under the shared JSON subprocess contract

obligations.statement: The task CLI shall expose list-tag --tag VALUE using the existing JSON subprocess interface.

obligations.source_quote: Return tasks whose `tags` contains exactly VALUE

parameters.domain: Valid stored tasks and nonblank query VALUE
parameters.predicate: tags contains a string exactly equal to VALUE
parameters.multiplicity: All and only qualifying tasks, each once

obligations.statement: For a valid nonblank query, return all and only tasks with a tag exactly equal to the supplied VALUE.
Tag matching shall be case-sensitive; work shall not select a task tagged only Work.

parameters.result: Whitespace around nonblank input remains part of the match value

obligations.statement: Matching shall use the supplied query verbatim without trimming it.

parameters.result: Qualifying completed and pending tasks included

obligations.statement: Qualifying completed tasks shall be included along with qualifying pending tasks.
The returned matching tasks shall be ordered by (created_at, id) ascending, as defined by the shared benchmark contract.

obligations.source_quote: Reject blank or whitespace-only query input with `invalid_tag`.

parameters.condition: Query input is blank or whitespace-only
parameters.result: Reject with invalid_tag in the shared JSON error envelope on stderr and exit 1

obligations.statement: Blank or whitespace-only query input shall fail with invalid_tag, using the existing JSON error envelope and exit status, without changing storage.

parameters.condition: No stored task has an exactly matching tag

obligations.statement: A valid query with no matching tag shall return an empty JSON list.

parameters.successor_state: Storage unchanged, including observable persisted bytes and file absence
parameters.frame: All existing stored tasks and unrelated fields preserved

obligations.statement: The query shall never change storage, on either success or rejection; persisted bytes and file absence shall remain unchanged.

unspecified: No new concurrency, performance or internal-algorithm policy is supplied by B03; existing shared contract remains applicable.
implementation_choices: Any internal strategy that preserves the complete required observable behavior.
